🐂 VINCERE TRADING
DAILY PROCESS • WEEKLY RESTART • NINJATRADER • WARNINGS

Start and Stop Process

ⓘAll times in ET. Follow the steps below to start or shut down your cash algo setup safely.
ⓘUsing Vincere Ninja Manager (VNM)? You don’t need this page, because VNM handles startup for you. This page is the manual startup and shutdown process.
1
Startup Daily or after a shutdown
By 9:28a ET or earlier
  1. Connect to your VPS by clicking the Remote Desktop shortcut (or the Windows App on Mac / Apple).
  2. Once the VPS loads in another window, double-click NinjaTrader to launch.
  3. Go to the Connections menu > Live.
  4. Verify charts are running (moving candlesticks).
  5. Check the Strategies tab: all strategy boxes should be green / true.
    NINJATRADER
    StrategiesStatus
    ● OGX   CashTrue
    ● RBO   CashTrue
    ● B2X   CashTrue
  6. Enable all strategies by 9:28a ET or earlier.
  7. You’re ready to trade. Leave NinjaTrader running.
Quick note: if NinjaTrader is already open, just go to Connections > Live and continue from step 3.
2
Shutdown Every 3rd day

Simply click the Red X in the Control Panel only.

⚠️ NOT in Charts or Backtest, they will be lost permanently.
Control Panel ✕
ConnectionsAccountsStrategiesPositionsLog
Live onlyConnected
3
Full Shutdown Every 3rd day

Close NinjaTrader completely from the Control Panel Red X to clear memory / cache and give the system a rest.

🔄CLOSE NINJATRADER
Clearing memory & cache…
4
Wednesday Restart After the trading day is over
  1. Wait until the trading day is over.
  2. Save your charts before you restart.
  3. Restart NinjaTrader.
  4. Reload your saved chart layout with the red icon in NinjaTrader, or the red icon on the desktop.
  5. The next morning, follow the Startup steps in Section 1.
5
Friday Shutdown For the weekend
  1. Wait until the trading day is over.
  2. Shut down NinjaTrader the same way as any other day.
  3. Leave it shut down until Sunday night or Monday morning.
Note: when you bring it back up, follow the Startup steps in Section 1.
⚠
Key Warnings
  • Never close charts with the Red X, they disappear permanently.
  • Never close backtest with the Red X, they disappear permanently.
ⓘThis process keeps your cash account setup stable, your algos running, and your data safe.
